title: Receding Horizon Control and Dissipativity - Optimal Control, Games and Uncertainty
summary: We provide a tutorial overview of receding horizon control across deterministic, stochastic, multi-agent, and game-theoretic settings. We contrast the minimizer of an optimal control problem with the equilibrium of a game in terms of cost and constraint handling to motivate the difference of MPC schemes involving multiple agents/players. Interestingly, dissipativity theory and the turnpike property have turned out to be a unifying thread and system-theoretic backbone across all these schemes.
